Envelope.description: How a request should travel. `payload` is a SignInMagicLinkRequest or an InvitationMagicLinkRequest serialised to a string, and it is signed as that exact string — never re-serialised, so the signature does not depend on JSON key order agreeing between the two ends. OWN_SECRET is the signing key and never leaves either end.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds. Inside the signature, so it cannot be adjusted.

InvitationMagicLinkRequest.description: The invitation of a new user: the same sign-in link, sent with the invitation text, which names who sent it.

email.description: Recipient address; must be on the vednemesicnik.cz domain.

inviterName.description: Who sends the invitation, as one string in the nominative: a single line with no e-mail address or link.

link.description: The sign-in verify URL. Must be an https link on the configured origin whose path is the verify route (/administration/sign-in/magic-link/verify).

mailerError.description: Present only when error is "mailer_send_failed": the underlying reason the delegated send failed.

description: Contract for the Vedneměsíčník administration magic-link web app. POST a SignInMagicLinkRequest to send a sign-in link, or an InvitationMagicLinkRequest to send the same link as the invitation of a new user; the response is a SignInMagicLinkResponse. The send is delegated to the Mailer, whose reason is surfaced in mailerError when error is "mailer_send_failed".
